docs.text:
import (
    "github.com/kakaoenterprise/kc-sdk-go/v2/config"
    "github.com/kakaoenterprise/kc-sdk-go/v2/services/mysql"
)

cfg, err := config.LoadDefaultConfig(ctx)
client := mysql.NewFromConfig(cfg)

resp, err := client.Backup.CreateMysqlBackup(ctx, *mysql.NewCreateMysqlBackupRequest(
    *mysql.NewCreateMysqlBackup("<name>", "<instanceGroupId>"),
))
